raw_responses.Bulgarian: DESCRIPTION: Фигурата представлява линейна диаграма, която илюстрира промените в съотношението на разреденост в зависимост от слоя. Оста X е обозначена като "Layer" и използва линейна скала с диапазон на стойностите от 0 до 23, като числовите етикети са разположени през равномерни интервали от 5 единици. Оста Y е обозначена като "Sparsity Ratio", използва линейна скала с диапазон от 0.0 до 1.0 и има етикети през интервали от 0.2. В графиката са представени три линии без допълнителни маркери за отделните точки. Синята прекъсната линия ("sparsity ratio before gate, avg 0.03") започва при слой 0 със стойност около 0.18, спада рязко до около 0.03 при слой 2 и остава почти без промяна, близо до 0.0, до края на оста X при слой 23. Оранжевата пунктирана линия ("sparsity ratio after gate, avg 0.44") започва при слой 0 със стойност близо до 0.98, плавно спада до около 0.18 при слой 13, след което варира, образувайки локален връх около 0.4 при слой 21, и завършва при слой 23. Зелената линия от тирета и точки ("sparsity ratio after average gate, avg 0.33") започва при слой 0 със стойност 1.0, намалява постепенно до около 0.1 при слой 13 и продължава с леки колебания между 0.05 и 0.15 до края на графиката при слой 23.
raw_responses.Chinese:
这张折线图展示了阈值为1e-2时SDPA输出的稀疏率（Sparsity Ratio of SDPA Output, Threshold 1e-2）。x轴标记为“Layer”（层），采用线性刻度，数值范围从0到23，无特定单位，数值刻度间隔为5。y轴标记为“Sparsity Ratio”（稀疏率），采用线性刻度，数值范围从0.0到1.0，无特定单位，数值刻度间隔为0.2。图表中包含三条无标记形状的线条。代表“sparsity ratio before gate, avg 0.03”的蓝色虚线在x=0处从大约0.18开始，在x=2处迅速下降至约0.04，随后在剩余的x轴范围内保持相对平稳，最后在x=23处结束于约0.0。代表“sparsity ratio after gate, avg 0.44”的橙色点线在x=0处从约0.98开始，呈现整体下降趋势，在x=7和x=8处出现约0.47的平缓期，随后继续下降至x=13处的约0.18，在x=21处出现约0.40的峰值，最后在x=23处结束于约0.38。代表“sparsity ratio after average gate, avg 0.33”的绿色点划线在x=0处从1.0开始，呈现下降趋势，在x=15至x=18之间降至约0.09的低谷，在x=21处有约0.11的微小回升，最后在x=23处结束于约0.04。

raw_responses.English:
The figure is a line plot titled "Sparsity Ratio of SDPA Output, Threshold 1e-2". 

The x-axis is labeled "Layer" and has a linear scale with tick marks at 0, 5, 10, 15, and 20. The data extends slightly past 20, ending at 23.
The y-axis is labeled "Sparsity Ratio" and has a linear scale ranging from 0.0 to 1.0, with tick marks every 0.2.

There are three data series shown in the legend:
1. "sparsity ratio before gate, avg 0.03": A blue dashed line. It starts low (around 0.18), drops quickly by layer 2, and stays very close to 0 for the rest of the plot.
2. "sparsity ratio after gate, avg 0.44": An orange dotted line. It starts high (near 0.98), decreases steadily until around layer 13 (reaching ~0.18), and then fluctuates between roughly 0.18 and 0.40 until the end.
3. "sparsity ratio after average gate, avg 0.33": A green dash-dot line. It starts at 1.0, follows a similar initial downward trend as the orange line but drops lower, reaching ~0.11 by layer 13, and then stays relatively low (below 0.15) with minor fluctuations until the end.

DESCRIPTION:
The line plot illustrates the sparsity ratio of SDPA output across different layers for three different gating conditions, with a threshold of 1e-2. The x-axis is labeled "Layer" and uses a linear scale ranging from 0 to 23, with numeric tick labels spaced at intervals of 5 from 0 to 20. The y-axis is labeled "Sparsity Ratio" and uses a linear scale ranging from 0.0 to 1.0, with numeric tick labels spaced at intervals of 0.2. The blue dashed line, representing "sparsity ratio before gate, avg 0.03", begins at approximately 0.18 at layer 0, sharply declines to near 0.04 by layer 2, and remains relatively steady near 0.0 across the rest of the x-axis, ending at approximately 0.0 at layer 23. The orange dotted line, representing "sparsity ratio after gate, avg 0.44", starts at approximately 0.98 at layer 0, exhibits a steady decline to roughly 0.47 at layer 7, continues to decrease to about 0.18 at layer 13, and then fluctuates between 0.18 and 0.40 for the remainder of the plot, ending at approximately 0.38 at layer 23. The green dash-dot line, representing "sparsity ratio after average gate, avg 0.33", begins at 1.0 at layer 0, declines to approximately 0.36 at layer 7, continues to drop to about 0.11 at layer 13, and then fluctuates slightly at low values between 0.04 and 0.13, ending at approximately 0.04 at layer 23.
raw_responses.German:
Das Liniendiagramm stellt die "Sparsity Ratio of SDPA Output, Threshold 1e-2" dar und vergleicht drei verschiedene Sparsity-Metriken über verschiedene Schichten. Die x-Achse ist mit "Layer" beschriftet, verwendet eine lineare Skala und reicht von 0 bis 23, wobei die numerischen Tick-Beschriftungen in regelmäßigen Intervallen von 5 angeordnet sind. Die y-Achse trägt die Beschriftung "Sparsity Ratio", verläuft ebenfalls linear und deckt einen Wertebereich von 0,0 bis 1,0 ab, mit Tick-Intervallen von 0,2. Die erste Linie, laut Legende "sparsity ratio before gate, avg 0.03", ist blau, gestrichelt und weist keine Markierungen auf; sie beginnt bei einem Wert von etwa 0,18 bei Layer 0, fällt schnell auf etwa 0,04 bei Layer 2 ab und verläuft danach nahezu konstant auf einem sehr niedrigen Niveau, bis sie bei Layer 23 nahe 0,0 endet. Die zweite Linie, "sparsity ratio after gate, avg 0.44", ist orange, gepunktet und ohne Markierungen; sie startet bei einem hohen Wert von etwa 0,98 bei Layer 0, sinkt kontinuierlich bis auf etwa 0,18 bei Layer 13, zeigt danach Schwankungen mit einem Anstieg auf etwa 0,28 bei Layer 19, einem Rückgang auf 0,19 bei Layer 20, einer Spitze von etwa 0,4 bei Layer 21 und endet bei etwa 0,39 bei Layer 23. Die dritte Linie, "sparsity ratio after average gate, avg 0.33", ist grün, strichpunktiert und hat keine Markierungen; sie beginnt bei 1,0 bei Layer 0, fällt stetig ab und erreicht etwa 0,36 bei Layer 7 sowie 0,11 bei Layer 13, woraufhin sie auf einem niedrigen Niveau mit minimalen Schwankungen verbleibt und bei etwa 0,04 bei Layer 23 endet.
